seoTitle: CSS Container Query Generator with cqi Units and Fallback
metaDescription: Generate CSS container queries for a card or component: name the container, set breakpoints on its width and get layout rules with container units.
intro: Make components respond to the space they are placed in, not just the viewport.
why:
The output declares container-type: inline-size and a container-name, adds base grid styles, fluid type using cqi units, two @container rules at your breakpoints, an example using the range syntax and an @supports fallback to media queries. The explanation covers what the query measures and why a container cannot style itself.

Container queries are supported in all current major browsers. Use media queries for page-level layout and container queries for reusable components.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
howTo: Name the container and give its selector.
Adapt the example rules to your component.

faq.a: A container query unit equal to 1% of the container's inline size.

faq.q: Why does the container not respond to its own query?
faq.a: A query applies to descendants of the container, not the container itself.
Use container queries for components; media queries for global layout and user preferences.
No. Everything is processed in your browser, and the page makes no network requests with your input.
